more_info.overview: Green S is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, jam jellies and marmalades and similar products, other similar fruit or vegetable spreads, processed fish and fishery products including molluscs and crustaceans. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Refined food-use estimates were below EFSA's limit.
Higher maximum-use estimates exceeded the limit for some children. Genotoxicity data were incomplete, although long-term and reproductive studies were negative.
